edition.notes: Catalog-level record created 2026-07-24. Yonge's nineteenth-century translation is public domain and widely retranscribed online (including at earlychristianwritings.com); its chapter divisions differ from the modern section numbering, so consumers must state which numbering their loci use. No exact artifact has been registered; publications consulting web transcriptions record their own access routes and limits locally.
edition.publication: In The Works of Philo Judaeus, the Contemporary of Josephus, translated from the Greek by Charles Duke Yonge, volume 3 (London: Henry G. Bohn, 1855)
edition.title: On the Life of Moses (Yonge translation)

work.author: Philo of Alexandria
work.description: Philo of Alexandria's two-book life of Moses. Book 2, sections 25-44 in the modern numbering, contains Philo's account of the translation of the Law into Greek at Alexandria, including the island of Pharos, the translators' verbal agreement described in prophetic terms, and an annual commemorative festival. Loci use book and section numbers.
work.title: De vita Mosis
